notes: Runtime values are sourced from environment variables; this file contains no credentials.
Ollama (https://github.com/ollama/ollama) runs the model on this deployment's own hardware; no provider API key is required.
Install the runtime with `make ollama-install`, then `make ollama-up` and `make ollama-pull`.
Model weights live in the Ollama store and are never committed to this repository.
Point DASHBOARD_ASSISTANT_REMOTE_BASE_URL at another host to use a shared or GPU-backed Ollama server.
